rationale: The report explicitly requires one listed mana charge for a successful actual arena cast and no additional mana spending or cooldown extension on a rejected recast. ChampionKit lists Morgana E at 70 mana and 14 seconds; DexArena.Cast calls BeginCast and grants a shield on success. The trace observes the shield and cooldown but mana falls from 900 to 760, reproducing the double charge. Retain the success control and report-derived resource assertions below. Unaffordable-cast, regeneration-rate and shield-refresh assertions are unnecessary to this frozen witness.
